name: dafa-warehouse
description: DAFA Warehouse - Hệ thống quản lý kho kính xây dựng DAFA Glass

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
